page: UpCloud GPU-32xCPU-384GB-3xL4 is a KVM-hypervised virtual server built on the x86_64 CPU architecture. It features 32 vCPUs with a shared CPU allocation model, paired with 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding 12.0 GB of RAM per core.

The server is equipped with three NVIDIA L4 GPUs from the Ada Lovelace architecture family, providing a combined total of 72 GB of VRAM. This configuration does not include any local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met through network-attached options. It includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

The shared CPU allocation presents a performance tradeoff for sustained, CPU-intensive tasks, but the high density of GPU resources and system memory offers qualitative cost efficiency for memory-heavy and parallelized workloads. This server is designed for workloads such as GPU-accelerated machine learning inference, data science jobs, and large-scale parallel processing that rely heavily on GPU VRAM and substantial system memory rather than dedicated CPU cores.
